name: representative-pilot
selection_rule: Stratify the currently rich/verified subset by object type, find context, siglum reconciliation and occurrence verification; do not imply corpus-wide representativeness.
scientific_boundary: Pilot describes encoded evidence only; corpus-wide frequency inference remains blocked.
freeze_policy: Membership and selection rules freeze before target-result inspection.
cross_corpus_rule: Pilot strata remain native; cross-script identity is never inferred by inclusion.
